why: Private fishing resort with RV camping but no camping price anywhere: its own site (anglerstrailresort.net /accomodations, read 2026-11-19) says only 'Our camping sites offer power and water availability, along with a central shower house' with no rate, site count or booking engine; Tourism Saskatchewan listing 636 and the fishhunt/canadianlodges listings say 'campsites' / 'Contact Lodge'; RV Life has no record (Algolia park index, query + 55.0-55.35N box, 2026-11-19). Presence would pass (website + phone 306-288-2122; Google 'Angler's Trail Resort' 4.1, 83 reviews, open, at 55.1717,-107.5050) but the private rule needs a price indicator too. Home page headed 'Fishing Resort For Sale - Northern Saskatchewan' (still says open year-round).
name: Anglers Trail Resort
flags: Separate business from 9185 Lac la Plonge Recreation Site: Google/Tourism SK point 55.1717,-107.5050 is ~1.0 km N of 9185's pin (55.1629,-107.5092); nothing about 9185 changes.
Resort is advertised for sale on its own home page (2026 copyright); camping is a sideline to 10 cabins, a 12-bed trailer home and 3 motel rooms.
Site count, seasonal share and RV fit unmeasured (no source gives them). A phone call to 306-288-2122 could supply the nightly RV rate if AWH wants it reconsidered (no call made).
